title: N3R3SH's Oth3r Us3ful Tags (N3OUT)
description: This mod adds some useful non-entity tags and adds to some tags from the game or other mods.
body:
This mod adds some useful tags that you can use in your mods, as well as providing additional entries to some vanilla, forge, c: and other mods' tags. It also uses a config to 'tag' unfortunately untaggable dimensions. And it also adds a recipe for arrows that uses these tags.

Current compatibility with:

Blue Skies

Diagonal Walls

LUMINOUS: BEASTS

LUMINOUS: OVERWORLD

MISC3LLAN3OUS

Quark

Vertical Slabs Compat
